name: Les Contes Magiques: Marie Lévesque
source:
You play as Marie Lévesque, a 2nd-year student at the prestigious Institut de Sorcellerie.
Since the beginning of civilization, this institute was built as one of many other guardian towers, meant to both train and employ defenders.

At first, Marie found her experience there to be rather easy-going. However, something ominous appears over the horizon. A female student goes missing, and then is found dead... and subsequently, others fall to the same horrifying fate. What exactly is going on here?

[From [url=http://www.spacenote.net/blog/a-demo-release-for-sunofes2015/]Official site[/url]]
translation:
你扮演玛丽·莱维斯克 (Marie Lévesque)，她是著名的巫术学院的二年级学生。
自文明开始以来，这座学院就作为许多其他守护塔之一而建造，旨在训练和雇用防御者。

起初，玛丽发现她在那里的经历相当轻松。然而，一些不祥的事情出现在地平线上。一名女学生失踪，然后被发现死亡……随后，其他人也陷入了同样可怕的命运。这里究竟发生了什么？

[来自[url=http://www.spacenote.net/blog/a-demo-release-for-sunofes2015/]官方网站[/url]]
